8 ابتدّاهُ بِاالضَّرْبِ They two took him on both sides of him, (T, S, K,) or came to him on both sides of him, (K,) with beating. (T, S.) ―
-b2- السَّبُعَانِ يَبْتَدَّانِ الرَّجُلَ The two wild beasts come upon both sides of the man. (S, A.) ―
-b3- الرَّضِيعَانِ يَبْتَدَّانِ أُمَّهُمَا (T, S, A *) The two sucklings suck their mother on either side, one from one breast and the other from the other breast. (T, A, * TA.) You do not say, يَبْتَدُّهَا ٱبْنُهَا, but يَبْتَدُّهَا ٱبْنَاهَا. (T, S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
